versions.changelog:
- Initial release of jd-express-tracker skill for JD Logistics tracking.
- Supports automatic JD waybill recognition and validation.
- Provides real-time tracking from pickup to delivery with detailed status updates.
- Offers delivery time estimation and exception diagnosis (e.g., delay, address issues).
- Enables batch tracking for up to 10 waybills at once.
- Exclusively supports JD-operated tracking numbers; third-party numbers not supported.
- Logistics data may have a 5–30 minute delay.
